camel_example: aliyun sas DescribePropertyProcDetail --region cn-hangzhou --User root --PageSize 10 --NextToken 'AAAAAV3MpHK1AP0pfERHZN5pu6k+AtdhNE3kgQEK36GujZ5on+tWdc+4WoaoMP/kUNxxxx' --ProcTimeStart 1648809853000 --ResourceDirectoryAccountId 1276085894170000 --ProcTimeEnd 1649587453000 --UseNextToken false --Remark '192.168.XX.XX' --Name 8888 --Uuid '50d213b4-3a35-427a-b8a5-04b0c7e10000' --CurrentPage 1 --Extend 1 --Cmdline './8888'
description_en: Queries the Asset Fingerprints information of process assets on a server
description_zh: 查询服务器的进程资产的资产指纹信息
kebab_example: aliyun sas describe-property-proc-detail --remark 192.168.XX.XX --name 8888 --user root --cmdline ./8888 --uuid 50d213b4-3a35-427a-b8a5-04b0c7e10000 --current-page 1 --page-size 10 --proc-time-start 1648809853000 --proc-time-end 1649587453000 --extend 1 --resource-directory-account-id 1276085894170000 --use-next-token false --next-token AAAAAV3MpHK1AP0pfERHZN5pu6k+AtdhNE3kgQEK36GujZ5on+tWdc+4WoaoMP/kUNxxxx --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribePropertyProcDetail

parameters.help_en: The name or IP address of the server that you want to query
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的服务器的名称或IP地址
parameters.name: remark

parameters.help_en: The information about the user that runs the process
parameters.help_zh: 运行进程的用户的信息
parameters.name: user

parameters.help_en: The startup parameters of the process
parameters.name: cmdline

parameters.help_en: The UUID of the server that you want to query
parameters.name: uuid

parameters.help_en: The page number of the page to return. Default value: 1, which indicates that the first page is returned
parameters.help_zh: 设置从返回结果的第几页开始显示查询结果。默认值为1，表示从第1页开始显示
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page in a paged query. Default value: 10, which indicates that 10 entries of process Asset Fingerprints information are displayed per page
parameters.help_zh: 设置分页查询时，每页显示的进程资产的指纹信息的数量。默认值为10，表示每页显示10条进程资产的指纹信息
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The start timestamp of the process startup time range. Unit: milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 进程启动开始的时间戳。单位为毫秒
parameters.name: proc_time_start

parameters.help_en: The end timestamp of the process startup time range. Unit: milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 进程启动结束的时间戳。单位为毫秒
parameters.name: proc_time_end

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether fuzzy match is supported for the process name. Set this parameter to 1 to enable fuzzy match. Other values or an empty value indicate that fuzzy match is not supported
parameters.help_zh: 进程名称是否支持模糊查询。要设置支持模糊查询时，请将该参数的取值设置为1，其他值或取值为空则表示不支持模糊查询
parameters.name: extend

parameters.help_en:
The Alibaba Cloud account ID of the member accounts in the resource folder.
You can invoke the [DescribeMonitorAccounts](~~DescribeMonitorAccounts~~) operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
资源目录成员账号主账号ID。
调用[DescribeMonitorAccounts](~~DescribeMonitorAccounts~~)接口可以获取该参数
parameters.name: resource_directory_account_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to use the NextToken method to retrieve the vulnerability list data. If this parameter is used, TotalCount is no longer returned. Valid values:

true: Use the NextToken method.
false: Do not use the NextToken method
parameters.help_zh:
是否使用NextToken方式拉取漏洞列表数据。如果使用此参数TotalCount不再返回。取值：

true：使用NextToken方式。
false：不使用NextToken方式
parameters.name: use_next_token

parameters.help_en:
The token that marks the current position from which to start reading. Leave this parameter empty to start reading from the beginning.

You do not need to specify this parameter for the first call. The NextToken value for the second call is included in the response of the first call. Each subsequent response contains the NextToken value for the next call
parameters.help_zh:
用来标记当前开始读取的位置，置空表示从头开始。

第一次调用不用填写，会在返回结果中包含第二次调用时用的NextToken，之后每次调用返回结果中都有下一次调用时的NextToken
parameters.name: next_token

PageInfo.description_en: The pagination information of the query result
PageInfo.description_zh: 查询结果页面显示的信息

Count.description_en: The number of process Asset Fingerprints entries displayed on the current page
Count.description_zh: 当前页面显示的进程资产的指纹信息的数量

CurrentPage.description_en: The page number of the current page in a paged query
CurrentPage.description_zh: 分页查询时，当前页的页码

NextToken.description_en: The NextToken value returned when the NextToken method is used

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page in a paged query. Default value: 10, which indicates that 10 entries of process Asset Fingerprints information are displayed per page
PageSize.description_zh: 分页查询时，每页显示的进程资产的指纹信息的数量。默认值为10，表示每页显示10条进程资产的指纹信息

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of process Asset Fingerprints entries returned
TotalCount.description_zh: 查询到的进程资产的指纹信息的总数量

Propertys.description_en: The details of the process Asset Fingerprints information returned
Propertys.description_zh: 查询到的进程资产的指纹信息的详情列表

Cmdline.description_en: The startup parameters of the process

CreateTimestamp.description_en: The timestamp of the most recent data collection. Unit: milliseconds
CreateTimestamp.description_zh: 最新采集数据的时间戳。单位为毫秒

EuidName.description_en: The running permission of the process

FileHash.description_en: The file hash of the process

InstanceId.description_en: The instance ID of the server associated with the process
InstanceId.description_zh: 进程关联的服务器的实例ID

InstanceName.description_en: The name of the server associated with the process
InstanceName.description_zh: 进程关联的服务器的名称

InternetIp.description_en: The public IP address of the server

IntranetIp.description_en: The private IP address of the asset

IsPackage.description_en:
Indicates whether the process is an installation package process. Valid values:

1: Yes.
0: No
IsPackage.description_zh:
是否为安装包进程。取值：

1：是
0：否

Md5.description_en: The MD5 hash of the process file

Pname.description_en: The name of the parent process
Pname.description_zh: 进程所属父进程的名称

StartTime.description_en: The time when the process started. The value is in the YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss format
StartTime.description_zh: 进程启动的时间。格式为 YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss

StartTimeDt.description_en: The timestamp when the process started. Unit: milliseconds
StartTimeDt.description_zh: 进程启动的时间戳。单位为毫秒

State.description_en: The running state of the process

User.description_en: The user that runs the process

Uuid.description_en: The UUID of the server associated with the process

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, which is a unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request. You can use this ID to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
